actual_coverage.scope: Bounded scheduled investigation using verified retained extracts; no monthly or quarterly observations interpolated into weeks

limitations: One issuer and two fiscal quarters are not an issuer panel. Currency, acquisitions and all discrete earnings items are not fully controlled.
Cash capex, leases, acquisitions, cash restructuring payments and working-capital conversion could not be reconciled.
BEA supplies two aggregate levels, not a revision history or industry decomposition. QFR and HSR retained representations supplied no eligible economic cells.
JOLTS covers total nonfarm establishments, not the issuer, and rounded flows do not reproduce exact payroll changes.
All numeric inputs were retrieved September 22, 2026; this September 29 run verified and reused the retained extracts but made no new provider observation or latest-release claim.
Prior own-domain reports and numerical results were available before analysis. This is exploratory reproducibility and reappraisal, not independent confirmation.
